analytical_coverage.scope_note: Dedicated monograph across V01–V15 by phase, from the hidden self-teaching of V01 to the V15 stairwell, with self-concept, motives, attentive and compelled modes, decision patterns, ordinary behaviour, family, relationships by person and written Japanese by interlocutor; the relationship study adds the directional coach–pupil history. Speech coverage is written Japanese wording and address, not acoustic performance. Japanese manga V01–V15 (Scores 1–61) to the warm-up before the Junior Grand Prix Final free skate, combined freeze MD-FR-FB02, with Official Fanbooks 01 and 02 as audited creator-layer supplements kept separate from story fact. The free skate and anything after Score 61 are outside the evidence. The animated adaptation, English editions and parody chapters are excluded.

notes: Her place on the ice held as a permission that results must justify: competence, agency and candour grow on an unchanged premise, and the V15 stairwell recasts care received as debt into a chosen role. The study withdraws its own V13 reading on V15 evidence and leaves the two V15 wishes, to carry and to vanish, undistinguished. No ethics or ideology dimension, diagnosis or operational model; inclusion assigns no reconstruction capability.

analytical_coverage.scope_note: Dedicated monograph on his history in story time and order of disclosure, his coaching method separated into diagnosis, pedagogy, perception of the athlete, decisions and her responses, the creed against sacrifice, relations with Inori Yuitsuka, Hitomi Takamine, Yodaka Jun and his other mentors and colleagues, body, ordinary behaviour and written Japanese address; the relationship study adds the directional coach–pupil history. Speech coverage is written Japanese address and register, not acoustic performance. Japanese manga V01–V15 (Scores 1–61) to the warm-up before the Junior Grand Prix Final free skate, combined freeze MD-FR-FB02, with Official Fanbooks 01 and 02 as audited creator-layer supplements kept separate from story fact. The free skate and anything after Score 61 are outside the evidence. The animated adaptation, English editions and parody chapters are excluded.

notes: A coach who learned in childhood that wanting costs someone: a perceptual eye, a practice of not overruling a child's stated purpose, and a creed against sacrifice he never applied to himself, which he names in V15 without the change yet being tested. The study keeps Kanayumi Miho's inference distinct from Inori Yuitsuka's own statement. No ideology dimension or operational model; inclusion assigns no reconstruction capability.
